trailhead.label: Top station of the Col Raiser gondola, above Santa Cristina, the board’s start

cautions: Steady descent of 560 m: hard on older dogs’ joints.
Cattle may graze the alp near Col Raiser in summer.
Gravel tracks shared with mountain bikers.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
